rigidAxioms: Standard 4-piece physical structure: Every skill requires SKILL.md, scripts/, references/, and templates/.
Dual-directory byte parity: .agents/skills/ and plugin mirror must remain 100% byte-for-byte identical.
JIT progressive disclosure: SKILL.md maintains high density (50-200 words); complex details deferred to subdirectories.
Rule catalog closure: All referenced rule IDs must exist in rule-catalog.json (RCFG-RULE-DRIFT).
Zero buzzwords & agent-native clarity: Objective constraints, unambiguous directives, and automated verification.
